## Description

Use this call to add custom Ask Seller a Question (ASQ) subjects to the seller's Ask a Question page, or to reset custom subjects to their default values. SetMessagePreferences is not an additive call; if you specify Subject values with the call, they replace any existing topics.

**Purpose:**
Use this call to add custom Ask Seller a Question (ASQ) subjects to the seller's Ask a Question page, or to reset custom subjects to their default values. SetMessagePreferences is not an additive call; if you specify Subject values with the call, they replace any existing topics. The call returns only Success or Failure along with any applicable error messages.

**Use Cases:**
- Sets traditional message preferences.

**Important Notes:**
- Sets traditional message preferences.
